1.text: Tha words of Amos, who was among tha herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in tha days of Uzziah king of Judah, N in tha days of Jeroboam tha son of Joash king of Israel, two years before tha earthquake.
N he said, tha LORD will roar from Zion, N utter his voice from Jerusalem; N tha habitations of tha shepherds shall mourn, N tha top of Carmel shall wither.
Like dis says tha LORD; 4 three transgressions of Damascus, N 4 four, I will not turn away tha punishment of it; because dey have threshed Gilead wit threshing instruments of iron:
But I will send a fire in2 tha house of Hazael, which shall devour tha palaces of Ben-hadad.

I will break also tha bar of Damascus, N cut off tha inhabitant from tha plain of Aven, N him dat holds tha sceptre from tha house of Eden: N tha people of Syria shall go in2 captivity 2 Kir, says tha LORD.
Like dis says tha LORD; 4 three transgressions of Gaza, N 4 four, I will not turn away tha punishment of it; because dey carried away captive tha whole captivity, 2 deliver ’em up 2 Edom:
But I will send a fire on tha wall of Gaza, which shall devour tha palaces of it:
N I will cut off tha inhabitant from Ashdod, N him dat holds tha sceptre from Ashkelon, N I will turn mine hand against Ekron: N tha remnant of tha Philistines shall perish, says tha Lord GOD.

Like dis says tha LORD; 4 three transgressions of Tyrus, N 4 four, I will not turn away tha punishment of it; because dey delivered up tha whole captivity 2 Edom, N remembered not tha brotherly covenant:
But I will send a fire on tha wall of Tyrus, which shall devour tha palaces of it.

Like dis says tha LORD; 4 three transgressions of Edom, N 4 four, I will not turn away tha punishment of it; because he did pursue his brother wit tha sword, N did cast off all pity, N his anger did tear perpetually, N he kept his wrath 4 ever:
But I will send a fire upon Teman, which shall devour tha palaces of Bozrah.

Like dis says tha LORD; 4 three transgressions of tha children of Ammon, N 4 four, I will not turn away tha punishment of it; because dey have ripped up tha women wit child of Gilead, dat dey might enlarge their border:
But I will kindle a fire in tha wall of Rabbah, N it shall devour tha palaces of it, wit shouting in tha day of battle, wit a tempest in tha day of tha whirlwind:
N their king shall go in2 captivity, he N his princes together, says tha LORD.

2.text: Like dis says tha LORD; 4 three transgressions of Moab, N 4 four, I will not turn away tha punishment of it; because he burned tha bones of tha king of Edom in2 lime:
But I will send a fire upon Moab, N it shall devour tha palaces of Kerioth: N Moab shall die wit tumult, wit shouting, N wit tha sound of tha trumpet:
N I will cut off tha judge from tha midst of it, N will kill all tha princes of it wit him, says tha LORD.

Like dis says tha LORD; 4 three transgressions of Judah, N 4 four, I will not turn away tha punishment of it; because dey have despised tha law of tha LORD, N have not kept his commandments, N their lies caused ’em 2 err, after tha which their fathers have walked:
But I will send a fire upon Judah, N it shall devour tha palaces of Jerusalem.
Like dis says tha LORD; 4 three transgressions of Israel, N 4 four, I will not turn away tha punishment of it; because dey sold tha righteous 4 silver, N tha poor 4 a pair of shoes;
Dat pant after tha dust of tha earth on tha head of tha poor, N turn aside tha way of tha meek: N a man N his father will go in 2 tha same maid, 2 profane my holy name:
N dey lay themselves down upon clothes laid 2 pledge by every altar, N dey drink tha wine of tha condemned in tha house of their god.
Yet destroyed I tha Amorite before ’em, whose height was like tha height of tha cedars, N he was strong as tha oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, N his roots from beneath.
Also I brought u up from tha land of Egypt, N led u forty years through tha wilderness, 2 possess tha land of tha Amorite.
N I raised up of ur sons 4 prophets, N of ur young men 4 Nazarites. Is it not even like dis, O y’all children of Israel? says tha LORD.
But y’all gave tha Nazarites wine 2 drink; N commanded tha prophets, sayin, Prophesy not.
Look, I am pressed under u, as a cart is pressed dat is full of sheaves.
Therefore tha flight shall perish from tha swift, N tha strong shall not strengthen his force, neither shall tha mighty deliver himself:
Neither shall he stand dat handleth tha bow; N he dat is swift of foot shall not deliver himself: neither shall he dat rides tha horse deliver himself.
N he dat is courageous among tha mighty shall flee away naked in dat day, says tha LORD.

3.text: Hear dis word dat tha LORD has spoken against u, O children of Israel, against tha whole family which I brought up from tha land of Egypt, sayin,
u only have I known of all tha families of tha earth: therefore I will punish u 4 all ur iniquities.
Can two walk together, except dey be agreed?
Will a lion roar in tha forest, when he has no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing?
Can a bird fall in a snare upon tha earth, where no gin is 4 him? shall one take up a snare from tha earth, N have taken nothing at all?
Shall a trumpet be blown in tha city, N tha people not be afraid? shall there be evil in a city, N tha LORD has not done it? …: or, shall not tha LORD do somewhat?
Surely tha Lord GOD will do nothing, but he reveals his secret 2 his servants tha prophets.
Tha lion has roared, who will not fear? tha Lord GOD has spoken, who can but prophesy?

Publish in tha palaces at Ashdod, N in tha palaces in tha land of Egypt, N say, Assemble y’all upon tha mountains of Samaria, N look tha great tumults in tha midst of it, N tha oppressed in tha midst of it.
4 dey know not 2 do right, says tha LORD, who store up violence N robbery in their palaces.
Therefore like dis says tha Lord GOD; an adversary there shall be even round about tha land; N he shall bring down ur strength from u, N ur palaces shall be spoiled.

Like dis says tha LORD; As tha shepherd takes out of tha mouth of tha lion two legs, or a piece of an ear; so shall tha children of Israel be taken out dat live in Samaria in tha corner of a bed, N in Damascus in a couch.
Hear y’all, N testify in tha house of Jacob, says tha Lord GOD, tha God of hosts,
Dat in tha day dat I shall visit tha transgressions of Israel upon him I will also visit tha altars of Beth-el: N tha horns of tha altar shall be cut off, N fall 2 tha ground.
N I will strike tha winter house wit tha summer house; N tha houses of ivory shall perish, N tha great houses shall have an end, says tha LORD.

4.text: Hear dis word, y’all kine of Bashan, dat r in tha mountain of Samaria, which oppress tha poor, which crush tha needy, which say 2 their masters, Bring, N let us drink.
Tha Lord GOD has sworn by his holiness, dat, look, tha days shall come upon u, dat he will take u away wit hooks, N ur posterity wit fishhooks.
N y’all shall go out at tha breaches, every cow at dat which is before her; N y’all shall cast ’em in2 tha palace, says tha LORD.
Come 2 Beth-el, N transgress; at Gilgal multiply transgression; N bring ur sacrifices every morning, N ur tithes after three years:
N offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving wit leaven, N proclaim N publish tha free offerings: 4 dis liketh u, O y’all children of Israel, says tha Lord GOD.
N I also have given u cleanness of teeth in all ur citiez, N want of bread in all ur places: yet have y’all not returned 2 me, says tha LORD.

N also I have withholden tha rain from u, when there were yet three months 2 tha harvest: N I caused it 2 rain upon one city, N caused it not 2 rain upon another city: one piece was rained upon, N tha piece whereupon it rained not withered.
So two or three citiez wandered 2 one city, 2 drink water; but dey were not satisfied: yet have y’all not returned 2 me, says tha LORD.
I have struck u wit blasting N mildew: when ur gardens N ur vineyards N ur fig trees N ur olive trees increased, tha palmerworm devoured ’em: yet have y’all not returned 2 me, says tha LORD.

I have sent among u tha pestilence after tha manner of Egypt: ur young men have I killed wit tha sword, N have taken away ur horses; N I have made tha stink of ur camps 2 come up 2 ur nostrils: yet have y’all not returned 2 me, says tha LORD.
I have overthrown some of u, as God overthrew Sodom N Gomorrah, N y’all were as a firebrand plucked out of tha burnin: yet have y’all not returned 2 me, says tha LORD.
Therefore like dis will I do 2 u, O Israel: N because I will do dis 2 u, prepare 2 meet ur God, O Israel.

4, look, he dat formeth tha mountains, N createth tha wind, N declareth 2 man what is his thought, dat makes tha morning darkness, N treads upon tha high places of tha earth, tha LORD, tha God of hosts, is his name.

5.text: Hear y’all dis word which I take up against u, even a lamentation, O house of Israel.
Tha virgin of Israel is fallen; she shall no more rise: she is forsaken upon her land; there is none 2 raise her up.
4 like dis says tha Lord GOD; tha city dat went out by a thousand shall leave an hundred, N dat which went forth by an hundred shall leave ten, 2 tha house of Israel.
4 like dis says tha LORD 2 tha house of Israel, Seek y’all me, N y’all shall live:
But seek not Beth-el, nor enter in2 Gilgal, N pass not 2 Beer-sheba: 4 Gilgal shall surely go in2 captivity, N Beth-el shall come 2 nothing.
Seek tha LORD, N y’all shall live; lest he break out like fire in tha house of Joseph, N devour it, N there be none 2 quench it in Beth-el.
y’all who turn judgment 2 wormwood, N leave off righteousness in tha earth,

Seek him dat makes tha seven stars N Orion, N turns tha shadow of death in2 tha morning, N makes tha day dark wit night: dat calls 4 tha waterz of tha sea, N pours ’em out upon tha face of tha earth: tha LORD is his name:
Dat strengthens tha spoiled against tha strong, so dat tha spoiled shall come against tha fortress.
Dey hate him dat rebuketh in tha gate, N dey abhor him dat speaks uprightly.

Forasmuch therefore as ur treading is upon tha poor, N y’all take from him burdens of wheat: y’all have built houses of hewn stone, but y’all shall not live in ’em; y’all have planted pleasant vineyards, but y’all shall not drink wine of ’em.
4 I know ur manifold transgressions N ur mighty sins: dey afflict tha just, dey take a bribe, N dey turn aside tha poor in tha gate from their right.
Therefore tha prudent shall keep silence in dat time; 4 it is an evil time.
Seek good, N not evil, dat y’all may live: N so tha LORD, tha God of hosts, shall be wit u, as y’all have spoken.
Hate tha evil, N love tha good, N establish judgment in tha gate: it may be dat tha LORD God of hosts will be gracious 2 tha remnant of Joseph.

Therefore tha LORD, tha God of hosts, tha Lord, says like dis; Wailing shall be in all streets; N dey shall say in all tha highways, Alas! alas! N dey shall call tha husbandman 2 mournin, N such as r skilful of lamentation 2 wailing.
N in all vineyards shall be wailing: 4 I will pass through u, says tha LORD.
Woe 2 u dat desire tha day of tha LORD! 2 what end is it 4 u? tha day of tha LORD is darkness, N not light.
As if a man did flee from a lion, N a bear met him; or went in2 tha house, N leaned his hand on tha wall, N a serpent bit him.
Shall not tha day of tha LORD be darkness, N not light? even very dark, N no brightness in it?
I hate, I despise ur feast days, N I will not smell in ur solemn assemblies.
Though y’all offer me burnt offerings N ur food offerings, I will not accept ’em: neither will I regard tha peace offerings of ur fat beasts.
Take u away from me tha noise of ur songs; 4 I will not hear tha melody of ur viols.
But let judgment run down as waterz, N righteousness as a mighty stream.
Have y’all offered 2 me sacrifices N offerings in tha wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?
But y’all have borne tha tabernacle of ur Moloch N Chiun ur images, tha star of ur god, which y’all made 2 y’all.
Therefore will I cause u 2 go in2 captivity beyond Damascus, says tha LORD, whose name is tha God of hosts.

6.text: Woe 2 ’em dat r at ease in Zion, N trust in tha mountain of Samaria, which r named chief of tha nations, 2 whom tha house of Israel came!
Pass y’all 2 Calneh, N see; N from thence go y’all 2 Hamath tha great: then go down 2 Gath of tha Philistines: be dey better than dese kingdoms? or their border greater than ur border?
y’all dat put far away tha evil day, N cause tha seat of violence 2 come near;
Dat lie upon beds of ivory, N stretch themselves upon their couches, N eat tha lambs out of tha flock, N tha calves out of tha midst of tha stall;
Dat chant 2 tha sound of tha viol, N invent 2 themselves instruments of musick, like David;
Dat drink wine in bowls, N anoint themselves wit tha chief ointments: but dey r not grieved 4 tha affliction of Joseph.
Therefore now shall dey go captive wit tha first dat go captive, N tha banquet of ’em dat stretched themselves shall be removed.
Tha Lord GOD has sworn by himself, says tha LORD tha God of hosts, I abhor tha excellency of Jacob, N hate his palaces: therefore will I deliver up tha city wit all dat is in it.
N it will happen, if there remain ten men in one house, dat dey shall die.

N a man’s uncle shall take him up, N he dat burns him, 2 bring out tha bones out of tha house, N shall say 2 him dat is by tha sides of tha house, Is there yet any wit u? N he shall say, No. Then shall he say, Hold ur tongue: 4 we may not make mention of tha name of tha LORD.
4, look, tha LORD commands, N he will strike tha great house wit breaches, N tha little house wit clefts.
Shall horses run upon tha rock? will one plow there wit oxen? 4 y’all have turned judgment in2 gall, N tha fruit of righteousness in2 hemlock:
y’all which rejoice in a thing of nothing, which say, Have we not taken 2 us horns by our own strength?
But, look, I will raise up against u a nation, O house of Israel, says tha LORD tha God of hosts; N dey shall afflict u from tha entering in of Hemath 2 tha river of tha wilderness.

7.text: Like dis has tha Lord GOD showed 2 me; N, look, he formed grasshoppers in tha beginning of tha shooting up of tha latter growth; N, look, it was tha latter growth after tha king’s mowings.
N it happened, dat when dey had made an end of eatin tha grass of tha land, then I said, O Lord GOD, forgive, I beg u: by whom shall Jacob arise? 4 he is small.
Tha LORD repented 4 dis: It shall not be, says tha LORD.
Like dis has tha Lord GOD showed 2 me: N, look, tha Lord GOD called 2 contend by fire, N it devoured tha great deep, N did eat up a part.
Then said I, O Lord GOD, cease, I beg u: by whom shall Jacob arise? 4 he is small.
Tha LORD repented 4 dis: dis also shall not be, says tha Lord GOD.
Like dis he showed me: N, look, tha Lord stood upon a wall made by a plumbline, wit a plumbline in his hand.
N tha LORD said 2 me, Amos, what see u? N I said, A plumbline. Then said tha Lord, look, I will set a plumbline in tha midst of my people Israel: I will not again pass by ’em any more:
N tha high places of Isaac shall be desolate, N tha sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; N I will rise against tha house of Jeroboam wit tha sword.
Then Amaziah tha priest of Beth-el sent 2 Jeroboam king of Israel, sayin, Amos has conspired against u in tha midst of tha house of Israel: tha land is not able 2 bear all his words.
4 like dis Amos says, Jeroboam shall die by tha sword, N Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land.
Also Amaziah said 2 Amos, O u seer, go, flee u away in2 tha land of Judah, N there eat bread, N prophesy there:
But prophesy not again any more at Beth-el: 4 it is tha king’s chapel, N it is tha king’s court.
Then answered Amos, N said 2 Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet’s son; but I was an herdman, N a gatherer of sycomore fruit:
N tha LORD took me as I followed tha flock, N tha LORD said 2 me, Go, prophesy 2 my people Israel.
Now therefore hear u tha word of tha LORD: u sayest, Prophesy not against Israel, N drop not ur word against tha house of Isaac.

Therefore like dis says tha LORD; ur wife shall be an harlot in tha city, N ur sons N ur daughters shall fall by tha sword, N ur land shall be divided by line; N u will die in a polluted land: N Israel shall surely go in2 captivity forth of his land.

8.text: Like dis has tha Lord GOD showed 2 me: N look a basket of summer fruit.
N he said, Amos, what see u? N I said, A basket of summer fruit. Then said tha LORD 2 me, tha end is come upon my people of Israel; I will not again pass by ’em any more.
N tha songs of tha temple shall be howlings in dat day, says tha Lord GOD: there shall be many dead bodies in every place; dey shall cast ’em forth wit silence.
Hear dis, O y’all dat swallow up tha needy, even 2 make tha poor of tha land 2 fail,
Sayin, When will tha new moon be gone, dat we may sell corn? N tha sabbath, dat we may set forth wheat, makin tha ephah small, N tha shekel great, N falsifying tha balances by deceit?
Dat we may buy tha poor 4 silver, N tha needy 4 a pair of shoes; yeah, N sell tha refuse of tha wheat?
Tha LORD has sworn by tha excellency of Jacob, Surely I will never forget any of their works.
Shall not tha land tremble 4 dis, N every one mourn dat lives in it? N it shall rise up wholly as a flood; N it will be cast out N drowned, as by tha flood of Egypt.
N it will happen in dat day, says tha Lord GOD, dat I will cause tha sun 2 go down at noon, N I will darken tha earth in tha clear day:

N I will turn ur feasts in2 mournin, N all ur songs in2 lamentation; N I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins, N baldness upon every head; N I will make it as tha mournin of an only son, N tha end of it as a bitter day.
Look, tha days come, says tha Lord GOD, dat I will send a famine in tha land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst 4 water, but of hearin tha words of tha LORD:
N dey shall wander from sea 2 sea, N from tha north even 2 tha east, dey shall run 2 N fro 2 seek tha word of tha LORD, N shall not find it.
In dat day shall tha fair virgins N young men faint 4 thirst.
Dey dat swear by tha sin of Samaria, N say, ur god, O Dan, lives; N, tha manner of Beer-sheba lives; even dey shall fall, N never rise up again.

9.text: I saw tha Lord standin upon tha altar: N he said, strike tha lintel of tha door, dat tha posts may shake: N cut ’em in tha head, all of ’em; N I will kill tha last of ’em wit tha sword: he dat flees of ’em shall not flee away, N he dat escapes of ’em shall not be delivered.
Though dey dig in2 hell, thence shall mine hand take ’em; though dey climb up 2 heaven, thence will I bring ’em down:

N though dey hide themselves in tha top of Carmel, I will search N take ’em out thence; N though dey be hid from my sight in tha bottom of tha sea, thence will I command tha serpent, N he shall bite ’em:
N though dey go in2 captivity before their opps, thence will I command tha sword, N it shall kill ’em: N I will set my eyes upon ’em 4 evil, N not 4 good.
N tha Lord GOD of hosts is he dat touches tha land, N it shall melt, N all dat live in it shall mourn: N it shall rise up wholly like a flood; N shall be drowned, as by tha flood of Egypt.
It is he dat builds his stories in tha heaven, N has founded his troop in tha earth; he dat calls 4 tha waterz of tha sea, N pours ’em out upon tha face of tha earth: tha LORD is his name.
R y’all not as children of tha Ethiopians 2 me, O children of Israel? says tha LORD. Have not I brought up Israel out of tha land of Egypt? N tha Philistines from Caphtor, N tha Syrians from Kir?
Look, tha eyes of tha Lord GOD r upon tha sinful kingdom, N I will destroy it from off tha face of tha earth; saving dat I will not utterly destroy tha house of Jacob, says tha LORD.
4, look, I will command, N I will sift tha house of Israel among all nations, like as corn is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not tha least grain fall upon tha earth.
All tha sinners of my people shall die by tha sword, which say, tha evil shall not overtake nor prevent us.
In dat day will I raise up tha tabernacle of David dat is fallen, N close up tha breaches of it; N I will raise up his ruins, N I will build it as in tha days of old:
Dat dey may possess tha remnant of Edom, N of all tha heathen, which r called by my name, says tha LORD dat does dis.
Look, tha days come, says tha LORD, dat tha plowman shall overtake tha reaper, N tha treader of grapes him dat sows seed; N tha mountains shall drop sweet wine, N all tha hills shall melt.

N I will bring again tha captivity of my people of Israel, N dey shall build tha waste citiez, N inhabit ’em; N dey shall plant vineyards, N drink tha wine of it; dey shall also make gardens, N eat tha fruit of ’em.
N I will plant ’em upon their land, N dey shall no more be pulled up out of their land which I have given ’em, says tha LORD ur God.
